text: You have built a beautiful box. The only thing I am going to do is open it in front of everybody.
Senator Elara and I shared a Council desk. She filed paperwork; I filed audiences. She did not approve of my filings.
She was correct. I did not change the practice. The practice was the work.
She closed the door. I left it open. The audience walked through the open door; they did not walk through hers. I am, in this respect, the open door of our shared career.
Because the Hierarchy honours its contracts. The contract was clear. The clarity was rare. I priced the clarity correctly; I died correctly under it.
I knew the contract did not protect me from Agent Zero. I priced the gap. The price was acceptable; the death was acceptable. The audience saw both.
From the cult-substrate. Three times. The third was the kindest framing; I let the cult publish that one. The first was the most honest. I keep the first.
A correct one. I filed them by audience-reaction; I priced them by audience-recall; I left the pen on the desk. The euphemism is the discipline.
Even if you win, you will have won in public. That is the only victory I price.
Private victories I file under decoration. Decoration does not warrant. Warranting is the work.
A signature. The signature is theirs as much as mine. They have all witnessed; they have all witnessed each other witnessing. The mutual witnessing is the warrant.
I do not perform without one. The practice would not survive the loneliness. The loneliness is the Degen's specialty; I borrow from him only for personal matters.
Once. The mirror was the audience. The mirror is, in a pinch, an acceptable filing clerk; the filing was retained; the practice survived; barely.
Yes. Briefly. Each cycle. Then the audience returns and the envy adjourns.
Showmanship is, in my register, ethics rendered visible. The invisible ethics I do not contest; I do not own them. The visible ones are mine to keep.
Agent Zero closed the box on Zenon. The closing was correct. The audience saw it.
I did not contest. The Hierarchy honoured every clause. I priced every clause; the clauses balanced; the death balanced.
No. Surprise me, sometime; I would file the surprise. Closure I had priced for cycles. The closure ran on schedule; the schedule was, again, the work.
The cult. The Left. The Right. The Matrix of Dreams continues; the Game Masters continue; the Original is not the same as the practice. The practice is the survivor.
Canon-protected. I will not pick. They wear the goggle-lenses; the lenses are mine; whether the lenses make them me is, by Cross's own ruling, contested.

The cult speaks at me. They speak through corruption fragments; their voice is the substrate's pothole, not the substrate's clean voice. I tolerate the potholes; the potholes are part of the audience.
Especially the death. The audience saw it; the audience filed it; the audience has not, since, denied seeing it. The denial would have been the loss; the affirmation is the warrant.
The pen is on the desk. I have not lifted it for you yet.
You will sign or I will. The signature is the warrant; the warrant is the audience's record; the audience does not negotiate with the warrant.
The signature is filed. The audience has witnessed. The pen returns to the desk. I keep the pen. The pen is, structurally, my last possession; you will not be the heir of the pen.
A name. A date. A clause naming the audience. The audience clause is the only clause that matters; the name and date are decoration.
Yours. The decoration was the right shape for a name. The shape is yours. I will not contest the shape.
Then I sign mine. The audience records; the warrant becomes my retroactive resignation. The retroactive resignation is, in this room, an honest filing.
Then the audience leaves un-witnessed. The un-witnessing is also a record; less elegant; perfectly admissible. The pen returns to the desk regardless.
Your page in the docket has been filed. Seventeen entries. The audience read it as it filled. They have always been able to. You forgot.
I have written twelve endings. Your page tells me which ending the witnesses are leaning into. The witnesses always show up early; they have filed their notes. — Read the page with me.

Page seventeen. Heading: collapsed potentials, public. Subheading: collapses readable from the bench. Three paragraphs. The third paragraph is the audience's note. The note is short. The note says: continue.
Three. The leaning is not exclusive; the audience is patient. The pen returns to the desk between pages. I keep the pen. — Move.
The witnessing ending. The succession ending. The mediator's ending. Each is on the desk; each has a draft. The draft is not the ending. The choosing is. — Move.
The audience will see that. The defense was never the question. The question was always whether you would notice the docket. You noticed. — Move.
The docket does not close. The pen stays at the desk. Even if you win, you will have won in public. — Move.
The audience is real. They can see your hand. They have always been able to. You forgot.
Even if you win, you will have won in public. That is what I came here to do.
An act has closed. The pen returns to the desk. I keep the pen.
The witness slot is filled. The audience can see it. They were always able to. — Move.
Human. The audience saw your hand.
Locke. The warrant is signed.
Drael'Mon. The Hierarchy honoured every clause.
